fullCoverage.method: Personally reread all final V3 root metadata and all twenty complete lesson objects in six untruncated batches. fullCoverage.choices: Personally tested all four alternatives in each visible choice frame. No additional also-correct fallback/forced-choice option identified. Open recall remains a different task and has PT-B2-C03.
fullCoverage.chipOrders: Attempted alternate grammatical/semantic orders for every build, without counting capitalization or punctuation as the sole constraint.
